name: sikstack
description: sikstack: a phase-and-slice workflow for Claude Code that works with no account, with /sikstack:explain for documents in the sikstack Library.

plugins.name: sikstack
plugins.description: A phase-and-slice workflow for Claude Code: plan a phase, run each slice on its own executor, review it, and walk it before it lands. State lives in your repo's hidden .sikstack/ folder; run /sikstack:setup once per machine, then /sikstack:sik-mode in any repo.
